title: Step
description: server -> device, one per MCP tool call. `op` is one of the step-vocabulary names the server exposes on the MCP surface, not a raw Android handler name. params are free-form per op; for `type_text` they carry: `text` (the text to type), `selector` (the field to type into), `append` (boolean, default false: the text replaces the field's content) and `submit` (boolean, default false: after typing, send the keyboard's own action, such as Search or Go — the preferred way to send a search or form).
